name: Zhejiang Semir Garment Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Semir Garment Co., Ltd. produces and sells casual apparels in China and internationally. The company provides men's, women's, and children's clothing, shoes, and accessories; home furnishings, and supplies; clothing for infants and toddler; uniforms and innerwear; women's dresses, knitwear, and skirts; and outdoor sportswear. It also offers its products under the Semir, Balabala, MARCOLOR, MiniBala, Semirkids, Heyjunior, AIKEN, JASONWU, SHUKU, VIVIDBOX, JuicyCouture, MarcO'Polo, AsicsKids, PUMAKIDS.
